name: columns
description: Lays its children out as equal columns when the container is wider than a threshold, and as rows when it is not.

attributes.name: data-threshold
attributes.description: The container width below which the columns become rows.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: Space between columns, and between rows once they stack.

attributes.name: data-justify
attributes.description: Distribution of the columns along the row when they do not fill it.

attributes.name: data-limit
attributes.description: The most columns allowed on one row; further children each take a full row.

children.description: The columns. Each gets an equal share of the row.
A child that takes several shares of the row: data-span="2" is twice a plain sibling. Below the threshold it stacks like the rest.

a11y.notes: Purely visual. Reading order is source order in both arrangements.
